The muon calculation now reconciles AE4's inverse-energy length prescription with the later operator-valued formation owner. The independent scalar impedance-law next step is withdrawn; no fitted energy or default heat length is installed.

The retained RHO-B2 denominator is R = gamma J_Sigma + H_impedance. On a selected formation-zero line, replacing R by bulk impedance alone leaves the exact residual -gamma <psi,J_Sigma psi>/<psi,M_E psi>. The retained records do not identify this formation line, dimensional common-charge normalization or event with AE4's support-loss/core crossing. A formation zero also need not be an energy eigenline, so bare Hellmann-Feynman cannot supply the missing mixed response.

The new report states the minimal same-action energy/event matching amendment and distinguishes it from a proposed compatibility schema. The finding is an unresolved owner identification, not a proof that compatible matching is impossible. The later formation rule supersedes the historical scalar holding interpretation without amending the full AE4 heat functional.

Conditional response machinery includes normalized generalized-eigenbranch complement solves, both moving-M terms, the mixed energy derivative and once-only crossing motion. Eight new targeted checks pass, including an independent mixed first-order equation/normalization solve. The 3-dimensional supplied arithmetic control is explicitly separate from physical BHSM operators; its residuals and finite-difference comparisons are not rigorous physical error bounds.

Evidence: theory/muon_native_impedance_energy_response_20261006.md and artifacts/muon_native_impedance_energy_response_20261006 contain owner chronology, exact reduction identities, conditional equations, 15 input/source hashes, executed source snapshots, review changes, replay, checkpoint and error scope. Existing local 32x8 mixed contacts, compact weak rows, both temporal cross terms, seven checks, primitive 240/32 response, family/mass/time jets, accepted parent solution and frozen locals are preserved without rerunning production.

Physical H/M/eigenline, E_vJ, length jets, full R_ind, native photon/family heat and a_mu/g_mu remain unevaluated. The next scientific operand is the same-action selected-line/common-charge energy and AE4 event identification, or an explicit already-owned alternative equality. No new state, coupling, seam proposal, boundary law or determinant is installed.
title: Reconcile BHSM muon heat length and formation operator
